node.statement: Dependency-explicit threshold chain. Validated node 1.1 defines the preliminary ledger witness e_s2^0=min{1/2,e_nest,e_ncd,e_out,e_sim,e_ca/2}; because e_nest is an entry of this finite minimum, e_s2^0<=e_nest. Validated node 1.5.2 defines the final witness e_s2=min{e_s2^0,e_{2,1}}, so e_s2<=e_s2^0. Therefore, under the root hypothesis t<=e_s2, transitivity gives t<=e_s2<=e_s2^0<=e_nest, exactly the threshold required by lem-maincb-nested-corner-comparison.
